description: This Java source file defines an enum called PartitionedJob that represents specific partitioned jobs within the application, specifically related to job partitioning for COB (Close Of Business) loan processing. It includes a constant for a particular partitioner step name and a method to check for the existence of a job by name.

classes.name: PartitionedJob
classes.description: An enum representing partitioned jobs with associated partitioner step names and a method to verify if a job exists by name.

methods.name: existsByJobName
methods.description: Checks whether a partitioned job with the given name exists in this enum.
